measurementBoundary: The public-feedback-interaction profile and its source closure retain their accepted measurement after public scene-graph metadata changed. On 2026-09-03 the UI Guidelines scene node moved from the Archie user-interface index to the Archie documentation index, which regenerated content/graph/scene_graph.json and changed the profile's source closure by two bytes, from 824446 to 824444, with the file count unchanged at seven. On 2026-09-04 the same generated graph incorporated the completed node move and a title-only Self-Energy metadata change, changing the closure by another twelve bytes, from 824444 to 824432, again with seven files. The closure fingerprint was re-pinned and the measurement was retained rather than re-asserted: these are navigation metadata changes outside the /feedback.html interaction path, and no file in the feedback entrypoint, stylesheet, runtime, or authored scene indexes changed. The retained cold-load encodedBytes of 824446 is the earlier measured transfer and is deliberately not edited. This profile's closure includes the generated scene graph, so any scene edit invalidates it; a change that touches the feedback route itself requires remeasurement rather than a re-pin. The photon-4k-visual profile was remeasured from the complete current source closure after shared Markdown runtime and pagination changes. The accepted current run used a fresh loopback origin in a dedicated Codex in-app Chromium 152 tab at exactly 3840 by 2160 CSS pixels and device-pixel ratio 1. Earlier wrong-device-scale and contention-bound samples remain rejected. The shared Codex GPU-process envelope retains its original foreground 2026-09-02 measurement because the accepted contract assigns that distinct shared-process instrument.

environment.browser: Chrome 152.0.0.0 through the Codex in-app browser for Public Feedback and the remeasured Photon profile
environment.server: scripts/dev/start-local-dev.mjs with EOM_BORG_SHADOW=0 and one fresh loopback port per cold profile
environment.cacheBoundary: Cold values use the first app load on a fresh loopback origin. Warm values use an identical same-origin reload with the development server's HTTP validation behavior retained. The refreshed cold profiles transferred their complete current source closures.
environment.claimBoundary: These are local pre-release measurements on two Chromium 152 browser surfaces and one host. They establish current regression budgets, not global user latency, network transfer, exact per-page GPU allocation, production performance, or hosting cost.

gpuSurfaceProxy.method: canvas backing-store lower bound; excludes textures, geometry, driver allocation, compositor copies, and shared GPU-process memory

gpuProcess.method: macOS ps RSS samples of the identified Codex GPU process before and during the foreground 4K profile
